data.name: CHK-001
data.value: Test the new configuration in a lab before production. Modified configurations are not supported by Fortinet TAC.

data.name: CHK-002
data.value: Bring both units to the same FortiOS version before restoring.

data.name: CHK-003
data.value: Check that passwords, pre-shared keys and certificates work on the target (ENC values depend on the encryption key).

data.name: CHK-004
data.value: Replace the config-version value at the start of the first line with the one of a factory-default backup of the target (FortiOS Best Practices, "Migrating a configuration manually").

data.name: CHK-005
data.value: Check where logs are sent now (FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate Cloud, syslog): disk logging settings changed or must be reviewed.

data.name: CHK-006
data.value: Review the "possible references" listed in the report.

data.name: CHK-007
data.value: Decide what to do with target ports not used by the migration.

data.name: CHK-008
data.value: Check hardware/virtual switch membership on the target (config system virtual-switch).

data.name: CHK-009
data.value: Check HA and MGMT port names on the target (not always in the documented port lists).

data.name: CHK-010
data.value: Register the new unit and check licenses and FortiGuard subscriptions.

data.name: CHK-011
data.value: Make sure you keep management access (admin interface, trusted hosts, management IP) after the restore.
